1. Unplug the power cable from the printer while it is powered on.
2. Wait 60 seconds to completely reset the printer memory.
3. Open all paper trays and doors to inspect for tiny paper bits or debris.
4. Gently clean the rubber paper rollers using a lint-free cloth lightly dampened with water.
5. Plug the power cable directly into a wall outlet and turn the printer on.
6. Send a new print job to check if the error is resolved.
If the error persists, contact IT Support for further hardware assistance.
